context: Bound at the earliest trusted chokepoint: submission validation gets a companion size cap and a receipt entry-count cap (explicit, documented limits with clear error text), and the pipeline enforces the same caps defensively with an explicit truncation marker so the UI can say 'receipt truncated'. Discovery: add is_file() to the two unguarded copies (or extract the shared discovery helper the three copies obviously want). Label: rename to 'Receipt entries (N)'. Seam: smallest honest fix - annotate the diff row when requested_config_hash matches.
description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review of the #1343 receipt ingestion and #1331 consumer sweep.

E4 (adversarial-input, merge-gated): the .applied.json receipt is unbounded end-to-end. Bundle validation checks companion filename/symlink/hash only (benchbox/validation/bundle.py:660-680); the explorer pipeline re-serializes receipt verbatim into results.applied_receipt (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py:303-332); RunReceipt.tsx:345 maps every entry into the DOM. A community submission with a valid bundle plus a 500k-entry receipt (matching companion_hashes digest) passes validation, bloats every snapshot consumer, and janks/OOMs viewers.

F9 (discovery inconsistencies): the pipeline's bundle discovery guards path.is_file() (pipeline.py:429) but the other two copies do not - benchbox/validation/bundle.py:728-739 and scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py:54-63 - so a directory named x.json in a community submission tree raises IsADirectoryError (unhandled traceback in a workflow that runs on contributor-controlled trees, scripts/validate_submission.py:84). Companion-suffix matching is case-sensitive everywhere (a hand-renamed foo.APPLIED.json becomes a bundle candidate and fails loudly downstream - confusing error, not corruption).

RR1 (label accuracy): RunReceipt.tsx:342 renders 'Statement receipt ({entries.length})' but post-#1331 entries are per-INTENT - a dual-key ClickHouse CREATE TABLE emits two entries with duplicated statement text, so the count over-states statements.

X1 (hash seam, smell): ComparabilityReceipt.tsx:283-301 folds applied_ledger_hash into the compared Tuning value; pre- vs post-#1331 runs of the SAME logical ClickHouse tuning show 'Tuning ... differs' warnings with no seam explanation (policy_generation.py:38 unbumped; its scope is policy seams, this is a hash seam). Decide: annotate the warning when requested_config_hash matches but applied hash differs, or document the seam in the receipt UI help text.

XSS explicitly disproven during review: all receipt fields render as JSX text children; no innerHTML in results-explorer/src. Do not add sanitization theater.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not fix the two unguarded discovery copies with divergent local patches
anti_patterns.instead: extract or align on a single shared discovery helper with tests
anti_patterns.why: three hand-rolled copies is how the is_file() inconsistency happened

anti_patterns.dont: Do not silently truncate oversized receipts
anti_patterns.instead: cap with a loud validation error at submission time and an explicit truncation marker at the defensive pipeline layer
anti_patterns.why: silent truncation reads as 'covered everything' and hides the adversarial input

anti_patterns.dont: Do not suppress the applied-hash diff row entirely to fix the seam warning
anti_patterns.instead: annotate the row when requested_config_hash matches instead of hiding it
anti_patterns.why: physically different applied statements across runs is real signal

deferrals.reason: todo-db PR #3 implements the rule in the standalone schema, but live BenchBox remains on the guarded legacy schema and standalone correctly refuses it; the embedded CLI is therefore the only authorized hosted write path that can unblock this item.
deferrals.summary: Add audited scope-rule mutation to the embedded BenchBox tracker CLI

preserves.behavior: Bundle discovery keeps rejecting companions as result bundles (the #1343 fix) across all three copies.
Rendering stays JSX-text-only for receipt fields; no innerHTML introduced.
Valid receipts of realistic size ingest byte-identical (verbatim contract) - caps must sit far above any legitimate run's entry count.
applied_ledger_hash remains display/warning-only - never a match, dedup, or facet key.
